name: @w6w-apps/boldsign
description: Send documents for e-signature, manage templates and track status via the BoldSign REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
BoldSign is an e-signature API. This app covers the document lifecycle a workflow drives against an account that already has files uploaded through BoldSign's own app or reachable at a public URL: send a document for signature, list and inspect its status, download the signed PDF and its audit trail, nudge pending signers, revoke a document, and mint an embedded signing link a workflow can hand to a UI. Template actions cover listing templates, reading a template's roles, and sending a document by filling a template's roles with real signers.

BoldSign's API host is region-sharded — an account (and its API keys) lives on exactly one of api.boldsign.com (US), api-eu.boldsign.com, api-ca.boldsign.com or api-au.boldsign.com, chosen at connect time.

Uploading a brand-new file isn't supported the way BoldSign's own dashboard supports it: this pack's Actions run in a sandbox whose ctx.fetch stringifies every request body, so a real multipart file upload cannot survive the trip. BoldSign's send/send-from-template operations accept a fileUrls list as an alternative to an uploaded file, and that is what this app uses — the document must already be reachable at a URL (already in BoldSign, or hosted elsewhere).
